actions.addImageToPdf.description: Stamp one or more images onto pages of an existing PDF.
actions.addImageToPdf.props.imageItems.d: One item per image. Each can target one page or all pages.
actions.addTextToPdf.description: Stamp one or more text strings onto pages of an existing PDF.
actions.addTextToPdf.props.textItems.des: One item per text block. Each can target one page or all pages.
actions.convertToImage.description: Render a PDF file or URL as PNG images.
actions.convertToImage.props.imageOutput: One tall image of all pages, or one image per page.
actions.extractPdfPages.description: Copy page ranges from a PDF into a new file, in the order given.
actions.extractPdfPages.props.markdown.d:
Ranges are copied in the order listed, so pages can be reordered.

- Pages start at 1. Start and end are inclusive; use the same number for one page.
- Negative numbers count from the end: -1 is the last page, -5 to -1 the last five.
- A range cannot cross 0.
actions.extractPdfPages.props.pageRanges: One item per range. Order here is the page order in the output.
actions.extractText.description: Extract the text layer from a PDF file or URL.
actions.fillPdfForm.description: Fill the fields of a fillable PDF form and get a new PDF.
actions.fillPdfForm.props.data.descripti: All the values as one object, for example {"city": "Austin", "agree": true}. Map it from an earlier step, or let an AI agent fill it. Each input in Option 1 shows the name to use here. When a field is set in both, this value wins.
actions.fillPdfForm.props.fields.descrip: One input per field found in the PDF, shown once the PDF Form is set.
actions.fillPdfForm.props.file.descripti: Its fields are found automatically. Use a fillable PDF from an earlier step or a URL.
actions.fillPdfForm.props.fileName.descr: Name of the new PDF. Leave empty to use the form's name.
actions.fillPdfForm.props.flatten.descri: Lock the values into the page. Keep it on before Merge PDFs.
actions.imageToPdf.description: Wrap a PNG or JPEG image in a one-page A4 PDF.
actions.imageToPdf.props.image.descripti: PNG or JPEG. Large images are scaled down to fit the page.
actions.inspectPdfForm.description: List the fields of a PDF form with their current values, and check whether Fill PDF Form can fill it.
actions.inspectPdfForm.props.file.descri: The PDF to inspect, from an earlier step or a URL.
actions.mergePdfs.description: Merge two or more PDF files into one document.
actions.mergePdfs.props.outputFileName.d: File name for the merged PDF, without the extension.
actions.mergePdfs.props.pdfFiles.descrip: Add the files in the order they should appear.
actions.pdfPageCount.description: Count the pages in a PDF file or URL.
actions.textToPdf.description: Create a new A4 PDF from plain text.
actions.textToPdf.props.text.description: Line breaks start a new paragraph. Helvetica 12 pt on A4.
